verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's review tools include a document blocklist. Once a reviewer manually adds a document, future verifications using that same document are blocked automatically, so repeat-document detection exists in a limited, reviewer-initiated form. There is no evidence of automatic duplicate detection across verifications without manual blocklisting, and nothing on face or selfie deduplication. Missing for 10: automatic cross-verification duplicate flagging without manual blocklisting, face/biometric duplicate matching, detection of the same identity under different names, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the platform detects repeat and duplicate identities across verifications — the same face or document resurfacing under different names is flagged automatically

citations.quote: Add the document to a blocklist to programmatically block future verifications completed with the same document.
While Stripe’s programmatic systems work to detect fraudulent verifications, you can perform manual reviews to provide an extra layer of fraud protection.
